verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that one SumUp account can pair, name, and run several Solo readers at the same time. Nothing documents a concept of locations, location-scoped device assignment, per-location settings, or per-location reporting. Multi-reader pairing under a single account is a related device feature, not multi-location management, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can run multiple locations with per-location devices, settings, and reporting
